representation.name: CBD cisplatin vs DMSO DESeq2
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
counts <- read.csv(args[1], check.names=FALSE, row.names=1)
layout <- read.csv(args[2], stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
mapping <- read.delim(args[3], stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
control <- "DMSO"
target <- "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50"
meta <- layout[layout$Group %in% c(control, target), c("SampleID", "Group")]
if (nrow(meta) != 6L) stop("Expected exactly six samples for target/control contrast")
matrix_cols <- gsub("-", "_", meta$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
if (!all(matrix_cols %in% colnames(counts))) stop("Sample IDs do not all match count-matrix columns")
count_matrix <- as.matrix(counts[, matrix_cols, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"
if (anyNA(count_matrix) || any(count_matrix < 0L)) stop("Counts must be nonnegative integers")
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(count_matrix))) stop("Duplicate Ensembl gene IDs in count matrix")
coldata <- data.frame(Group=factor(meta$Group, levels=c(control, target)), row.names=matrix_cols)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_matrix, colData=coldata, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("Group", target, control), alpha=0.05)
result_table <- data.frame(gene_id=rownames(res), as.data.frame(res), check.names=FALSE)
write.table(result_table, file="deseq2_results.tsv", sep="	", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="NA")
selected <- result_table[!is.na(result_table$padj) & result_table$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(result_table$log2FoldChange) & abs(result_table$log2FoldChange) >= 0.5, , drop=FALSE]
if (!all(c("ENSG", "gene_name") %in% names(mapping))) stop("Mapping file lacks ENSG/gene_name columns")
symbols <- mapping$gene_name[match(selected$gene_id, mapping$ENSG)]
symbols <- unique(symbols[!is.na(symbols) & nzchar(symbols)])
if (length(symbols) == 0L) stop("No mapped DEG symbols after requested filters")
writeLines(symbols, con="deg_gene_symbols.txt")
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.layout.path)" "$(inputs.mapping.path)"
